approval.question: 是否允许按上图中已确认属于小车的固定 IMU 外形，修订自体遮罩？草案仅补入白色 IMU 上缘内部2498个像素，用于阻止自体深度成为环境障碍；原遮罩、原始数据、旧地图和失败记录均保留，不删除外部障碍。批准后我会冻结新版本，再准备下一次真实闭环。这是在修订 Goal 的固定遮罩限制，不是重新索取运动许可。
approval.scope: Exact reviewed fixed-body silhouette change only; not fresh physical site facts or new motion authorization.

identification_basis: User-confirmed fixed foreground IMU; first-qualified saved RGB reviewed by parent and independent reviewer. Added pixels lie inside visible white upper surface; no visible environment intrusion in that fixed view.
limitations: Single fixed mounting/image geometry; invalidate upon camera mounting, calibration, resolution or self-geometry change. This is not an independent metric calibration.
use: Exclude fixed self pixels from geometric evidence only. Never label free, clear historical cells, alter raw source messages or import an old map.
authorization_basis: User requested resumption of actual robot task after review recommending the fixed-body input correction; same previously approved polygon, pixel-area rasterization only
rasterization: positive-area intersection with centered unit pixel squares

current_mount_review.review: Original fixed foreground white/gray plate remains at the same lower image boundary; no environment-based filter

approval_scope_note: Original approval retained for source silhouette identity; no new human answer fabricated. Current authorized task implements the documented rasterization correction.
